test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said to her, “Do you know French?”

options.text: He asked her if she knew French.
He asked her whether she has known French.
He asked her that does she know French.
He asked her if she knows French.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Direct speech to indirect speech conversion follows a specific structure.
 
• The given sentence is an interrogative sentence.
 
• In indirect speech, "said to" is changed to "asked" in reported speech.
 
• The question word “Do” is removed, and "if" or "whether" is used to introduce the reported clause.
 
• The verb tense changes from present simple ("know") to past simple ("knew") because of the reporting verb in the past tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He asked her if she knew French."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"He asked her whether she has known French." – Incorrect as "has known" is present perfect, which is not needed here.
 
• **Option 3: **"He asked her that does she know French." – Incorrect structure; "that" is not used in reported questions.
 
• **Option 4: **"He asked her if she knows French." – Incorrect as it does not change the verb tense properly.
